name: XI · Justice
title: VIII · Justice (La Justice)
imagery: A crowned woman sits facing us between two pillars, holding an upright sword in one hand and a set of scales in the other. Her gaze is direct and unblinking. In the Marseille deck she is number VIII, placed before the Hermit.
meaning: La Justice weighs and decides. She stands for truth, fairness and the clear consequences of our actions. This card asks you to look honestly at the facts, weigh both sides and act with integrity. Legal matters, contracts and decisions are highlighted. What is fair will be restored, and you are asked to take responsibility for your part.
numerology: Eight is balance and order, two squares held in equilibrium. Here it brings measured judgment.
affirmation: I act with honesty and accept what is fair.

ctx.past: A past decision or consequence shaped where you are. Justice was served, or a lesson in fairness was learned.
ctx.present: A decision must be made with a clear head. Weigh the facts, be honest and act with integrity.
ctx.future: A fair outcome is coming. Legal matters or agreements will be resolved according to the truth.
ctx.challenge: Bias, dishonesty or avoiding responsibility is the problem. Cold judgment without compassion also unbalances the scales.
ctx.advice: Be objective. Gather the facts, consider all sides and make the fair choice even if it is hard.
ctx.self: You see yourself as fair and principled. Make sure you weigh your own needs too.
ctx.others: Others expect honesty and accountability. A legal or official party may be involved.
ctx.hopes: You hope for fairness and fear judgment. Truth, in the end, protects you.
ctx.love: Love needs balance and honesty. Commitments and agreements between partners are highlighted.
ctx.work: Contracts, negotiations and legal matters. Fair dealing brings lasting success.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you that every action has its consequence. Walk in integrity.
ctx.release: Release resentment over past unfairness and the need to judge yourself harshly.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a truth you are avoiding, or guilt that needs honest resolution.
ctx.foundation: Cause and effect underlie this matter. Past choices are shaping present results.
ctx.gift: Your gift is clarity. You can see what is fair and act on it.

name: XII · The Hanged Man
title: XII · The Hanged Man (Le Pendu)
imagery: A young man hangs upside down by one foot from a crossbar set between two trees whose branches have been cut back. His free leg bends behind the other and his hands are held behind his back. His face is calm, even peaceful, as if he chose this view of the world.
meaning: Le Pendu is suspension: a pause in which you cannot force progress, only change your point of view. This card asks you to stop struggling, surrender control and see the situation from a completely different angle. What looks like a setback may be the doorway to insight. Sometimes the wisest action is to wait.
numerology: Twelve completes a great cycle, like the months of the year. It marks a pause before deep transformation.
affirmation: I surrender and see with new eyes.

ctx.past: A period of waiting or sacrifice changed how you see life. That pause brought hard-won insight.
ctx.present: Things are on hold. Use this time to reflect and look at the situation from a new angle.
ctx.future: A pause, delay or surrender is coming, and it will bring clarity rather than loss.
ctx.challenge: Being stuck or playing the martyr is the obstacle. Waiting should be chosen, not endured in resentment.
ctx.advice: Stop pushing. Let go, change your perspective and allow the answer to come.
ctx.self: You see yourself as in limbo or misunderstood. Your unusual view is valuable.
ctx.others: Others may not understand your choices. Someone around you may be in a holding pattern.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a breakthrough and fear being stuck forever. This pause will end.
ctx.love: Love may be on hold, or ask for sacrifice and patience. See your partner with fresh eyes.
ctx.work: Projects may be delayed. Use the time to rethink your approach rather than force it.
ctx.spirit: Your guides invite surrender. Spiritual insight comes when you stop resisting.
ctx.release: Release control and the need for things to happen on your schedule.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a habit of self-sacrifice that keeps you from your own needs.
ctx.foundation: A need for a new perspective underlies this matter. Old ways of seeing no longer work.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to see what others miss by turning the world upside down.

name: XIII · Death
title: XIII · The Nameless Arcanum
imagery: A skeleton swings a scythe across dark ground where heads, hands and feet lie scattered, one of the heads still wearing a crown. Small plants sprout among them. In the Marseille deck this card carries a number but no name, as if its power were too great to speak.
meaning: The Nameless Arcanum is the great clearing. It cuts away what is finished so that new life can grow, and it spares no rank, as the crowned head shows. This card rarely means physical death; it marks transformation, endings and the fertile ground they leave behind. Let go of what is over. Something new is already sprouting.
numerology: Thirteen breaks the cycle of twelve and begins anew. It is the number of radical change.
affirmation: I release what is finished and make room for new life.

ctx.past: A major ending in your past cleared the way for who you are now. That loss became your renewal.
ctx.present: Something is ending. Let it go cleanly, and trust that the ground is being cleared for growth.
ctx.future: Deep change is coming. An old chapter closes and a fresh one begins.
ctx.challenge: Clinging to what is already over is the obstacle. Resistance makes the cut more painful.
ctx.advice: Cut away what no longer serves you, whether habits, roles or situations. Make room.
ctx.self: You see yourself in the middle of transformation. You are shedding an old identity.
ctx.others: Others may be going through endings too, or reacting to the changes you are making.
ctx.hopes: You hope for renewal and fear loss. Both are part of the same turning.
ctx.love: A relationship transforms, or one ends to make way for something truer.
ctx.work: A job, project or way of working comes to an end. A clean slate follows.
ctx.spirit: Your guides honor the sacred cycle of death and rebirth. Release with gratitude.
ctx.release: This is the card of release itself. Let go fully, and do not look back.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of change that keeps you living in the past.
ctx.foundation: An ending underlies this matter. Something must finish before anything new can grow.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to clear away what is dead and begin again.

name: XIV · Temperance
title: XIIII · Temperance (Tempérance)
imagery: A winged angel with a flower in her hair pours a stream of liquid from one vessel into another, the flow arcing gracefully between blue and red. She stands on uneven ground, calm and absorbed in her task. Nothing spills.
meaning: Tempérance is the art of mixing just right. She blends opposites, heals divisions and finds the middle way. This card asks for patience, moderation and steady care. Healing is happening, but slowly, one careful pour at a time. Bring calm to the situation, and let different parts of your life flow together in harmony.
numerology: Fourteen, written XIIII, is twice seven: effort refined into balance and grace.
affirmation: I find balance and let healing flow.

ctx.past: A time of healing or finding balance shaped you. You learned the value of moderation.
ctx.present: Balance is needed. Blend different needs and move at a steady, patient pace.
ctx.future: Healing and harmony are coming. Things will settle into a gentle, sustainable rhythm.
ctx.challenge: Excess or impatience is the obstacle. Too much of anything throws off the mix.
ctx.advice: Moderate, blend and be patient. Find the middle path and let things flow.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a peacemaker or healer. Remember to care for yourself too.
ctx.others: A calm, balanced person may help. Others value your ability to keep the peace.
ctx.hopes: You hope for peace and fear imbalance. Harmony is built a little at a time.
ctx.love: Love is harmonious and healing. Compromise and patience strengthen the bond.
ctx.work: Steady progress, cooperation and good teamwork. Avoid burnout through balance.
ctx.spirit: Your guides bring healing. Your spirit is blending with something greater.
ctx.release: Release extremes and the urge to rush the process.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be an imbalance you have been ignoring, perhaps in health or habits.
ctx.foundation: A need for balance underlies this matter. The right mix is the key.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to heal and harmonize.

name: XV · The Devil
title: XV · The Devil (Le Diable)
imagery: A winged, horned figure stands on a pedestal, part animal and part human, holding a torch or blade. Two smaller horned figures are tied by ropes around their necks to the base of his stand. The ropes are loose enough that they could slip free if they chose.
meaning: Le Diable shows the pull of desire, attachment and power. He can mean intense passion, raw creative energy and material ambition, but also the chains of addiction, obsession and unhealthy bonds. This card asks what holds you and whether you are truly bound. The ropes are loose. You have more freedom than you think.
numerology: Fifteen reduces to six, the number of the Lover. Here desire and choice become a test of freedom.
affirmation: I see my chains clearly and choose my freedom.

ctx.past: A past attachment, addiction or unhealthy bond shaped you. You may still feel its pull.
ctx.present: Something has a grip on you, a desire, habit or relationship. Look at it honestly.
ctx.future: Temptation or intense passion is coming. Enjoy it consciously, without losing yourself.
ctx.challenge: Obsession, addiction or control is the obstacle. You are more free than you believe.
ctx.advice: Name what binds you. Loosen the rope, and take back your power.
ctx.self: You may feel trapped or driven by desire. Your shadow has power you can reclaim.
ctx.others: Someone may be controlling or tempting you. Watch for manipulation.
ctx.hopes: You hope for satisfaction and fear being trapped. Freedom begins with awareness.
ctx.love: Passion runs high, possibly obsessive. Check whether the bond is healthy or binding.
ctx.work: Ambition and material success are strong, but watch for greed or toxic workplaces.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to face your shadow. Integration, not shame, sets you free.
ctx.release: Release unhealthy attachments, habits or relationships that keep you small.
ctx.shadow: This card is the shadow itself: hidden desires, fears and compulsions waiting to be seen.
ctx.foundation: Attachment or desire underlies this matter. Something is holding on tight.
ctx.gift: Your gift is raw vitality and the power to transform desire into creation.

name: XVI · The Tower
title: XVI · The House of God (La Maison Dieu)
imagery: A tall tower with a crown-like top is struck open by a plume of fire from the sky. Two figures tumble headfirst to the ground, and colored balls rain down around them. The building is called the House of God, a place where heaven breaks through.
meaning: La Maison Dieu is the sudden break that sets you free. False structures fall, truth bursts through and nothing can stay hidden. It can feel shocking, but what falls was not built to last. This card asks you to let the walls come down and welcome the clarity that follows. Heaven has entered the house.
numerology: Sixteen reduces to seven, effort and movement. Here effort meets sudden release.
affirmation: When false walls fall, I find my freedom.

ctx.past: A sudden upheaval in your past broke something open. You were freed, even if it hurt.
ctx.present: Change is crashing in, or truth is breaking through. Let it happen and stay grounded.
ctx.future: A shake-up is coming that will clear away illusions. Expect a breakthrough.
ctx.challenge: Holding on to crumbling structures is the obstacle. Resistance makes the fall harder.
ctx.advice: Let go of what is built on false ground. Speak the truth and welcome the change.
ctx.self: You may feel shaken or exposed. This is your chance to rebuild authentically.
ctx.others: An unexpected event or person disrupts things. Others may react strongly.
ctx.hopes: You hope for liberation and fear chaos. They may arrive together.
ctx.love: A sudden revelation shakes the relationship. Truth will set the bond free or end it.
ctx.work: A sudden change at work, a shake-up or a revelation. It clears space for better.
ctx.spirit: Your guides send a lightning flash of awakening. Spirit enters through the cracks.
ctx.release: Release false beliefs and structures that were never truly yours.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a truth you have been building walls against.
ctx.foundation: Something built on shaky ground underlies this matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is resilience and the ability to rebuild from truth.

name: XVII · The Star
title: XVII · The Star (L'Étoile)
imagery: A nude woman kneels by a river, pouring water from two jugs, one onto the land and one into the stream. Above her shines a great eight-pointed star surrounded by seven smaller ones, and a bird perches on a nearby tree. She gives freely, with nothing hidden.
meaning: L'Étoile brings hope after hardship. She is open, generous and connected to the source of life. This card promises renewal, inspiration and healing. It asks you to trust the future, give from your fullness and let yourself be seen. The stars are guiding you.
numerology: Seventeen reduces to eight, balance renewed. Here it brings harmony after the storm.
affirmation: I am renewed, hopeful and open to the future.

ctx.past: A time of healing and hope helped you recover from difficulty. That renewal still sustains you.
ctx.present: Hope is returning. You are healing and opening to new possibilities.
ctx.future: Inspiration and renewal are coming. A brighter chapter lies ahead.
ctx.challenge: Losing faith or waiting passively is the obstacle. Hope needs your participation.
ctx.advice: Trust, give freely and follow your guiding star. Let yourself be vulnerable.
ctx.self: You see yourself as healing and hopeful. Your openness is a strength.
ctx.others: Others find you inspiring. A generous person may offer help.
ctx.hopes: This is the card of hope itself. Your wish for renewal is close to coming true.
ctx.love: Love is healing and sincere. Open your heart without fear.
ctx.work: Creative inspiration and a hopeful new direction. Your vision attracts support.
ctx.spirit: Your guides shine on you. Spiritual renewal and faith are strong now.
ctx.release: Release despair and the need to hide your true self.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of hoping again after past disappointment.
ctx.foundation: Hope and renewal underlie this matter. Healing is the deeper current.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to inspire and to heal through generosity.

name: XVIII · The Moon
title: XVIII · The Moon (La Lune)
imagery: A moon with a face in profile hangs above two towers, drops rising toward it. Below, two dogs howl at the sky, and a crayfish lies in a pool of dark water at the bottom of the card. The scene is eerie, dreamlike and full of shifting light.
meaning: La Lune rules the realm of dreams, instincts and the unknown. Things are not as clear as they seem; shadows play tricks. This card asks you to trust your intuition while staying alert to illusion. Emotions and the unconscious are stirring. Move carefully, and let the moonlight show you what daylight cannot.
numerology: Eighteen reduces to nine, completion and wisdom. Here wisdom comes through the unconscious.
affirmation: I trust my intuition through the shadows.

ctx.past: A confusing or dreamlike period shaped you. Old fears or illusions may still linger.
ctx.present: Things are unclear. Trust your instincts but double-check facts before acting.
ctx.future: A period of uncertainty or deep intuition is coming. Dreams may bring messages.
ctx.challenge: Illusion, anxiety or deception is the obstacle. Fear can distort what you see.
ctx.advice: Listen to your dreams and gut, but wait for clarity before big decisions.
ctx.self: You see yourself as intuitive or confused. Your inner world is rich.
ctx.others: Someone may not be fully honest, or may be confused themselves.
ctx.hopes: You hope for clarity and fear the unknown. The moon guides through the dark.
ctx.love: Feelings are deep but unclear. Avoid assumptions; let the truth surface.
ctx.work: Uncertainty at work. Creative and intuitive work thrives, but check contracts.
ctx.spirit: Your guides speak through dreams and symbols. Pay attention to night messages.
ctx.release: Release fears rooted in the past and illusions you have been holding.
ctx.shadow: This card is the realm of the shadow: hidden fears and instincts rising.
ctx.foundation: The unconscious underlies this matter. Feelings run deeper than facts.
ctx.gift: Your gift is a powerful intuition and imagination.

name: XIX · The Sun
title: XVIIII · The Sun (Le Soleil)
imagery: A great sun with a face shines down, its rays and drops falling on two children who stand close together before a low wall. One touches the other in friendship. Everything is lit, simple and warm.
meaning: Le Soleil is joy, clarity and success. Under its light, everything is seen clearly and life feels good. The two children speak of friendship, partnership and simple happiness. This card promises warmth, vitality and positive outcomes. Enjoy it, share it and let yourself shine.
numerology: Nineteen, written XVIIII, reduces to one: a new beginning bathed in light.
affirmation: I shine and share my joy freely.

ctx.past: A happy, successful time in your past lifted you. That warmth still lives in you.
ctx.present: Joy and clarity are here. Things are going well; enjoy the light.
ctx.future: Success, happiness and good news are coming. Bright days ahead.
ctx.challenge: Overconfidence or ignoring shadows is the only risk. Stay humble in the light.
ctx.advice: Be open, joyful and generous. Share your success and let others in.
ctx.self: You see yourself as confident and happy. Your warmth draws people to you.
ctx.others: Friends and supporters surround you. Others see your light.
ctx.hopes: You hope for happiness and success, and they are very likely.
ctx.love: Love is joyful, open and warm. A happy partnership or friendship blossoms.
ctx.work: Success, recognition and positive results. Your work shines.
ctx.spirit: Your guides bless you with clarity and joy. Your spirit is radiant.
ctx.release: Release doubt and the habit of dimming your light for others.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear that happiness will not last. Enjoy it anyway.
ctx.foundation: Joy and vitality underlie this matter. It is fundamentally positive.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiant warmth that brightens everyone around you.

name: XX · Judgement
title: XX · Judgement (Le Jugement)
imagery: An angel bursts from the clouds blowing a trumpet hung with a cross-marked flag. Below, three figures rise from an open tomb, the middle one shown from behind. They answer the call with raised hands and open hearts.
meaning: Le Jugement is the wake-up call. Something is calling you to rise, renew and answer a higher purpose. This card speaks of rebirth, forgiveness and the end of an old way of life. It asks you to listen to that inner trumpet and step into who you are meant to be.
numerology: Twenty reduces to two, receptivity. Here it means hearing and answering the call.
affirmation: I answer my calling and rise renewed.

ctx.past: A past awakening changed your life. You heard a call and answered it.
ctx.present: A call is sounding now. It is time to rise, decide and renew yourself.
ctx.future: A rebirth or major realization is coming. You will see your path clearly.
ctx.challenge: Ignoring the call or harsh self-judgment is the obstacle. Forgive and rise.
ctx.advice: Listen to your calling. Make the decision you have been avoiding.
ctx.self: You see yourself as awakening. A new version of you is rising.
ctx.others: Others may call you to account or call you to something greater.
ctx.hopes: You hope for renewal and fear being judged. The call is an invitation.
ctx.love: A relationship is reborn or reevaluated. Forgiveness opens a new chapter.
ctx.work: A calling or vocation becomes clear. A career rebirth is possible.
ctx.spirit: Your guides sound the trumpet. Spiritual awakening is here.
ctx.release: Release guilt and old judgments of yourself and others.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a calling you have been afraid to answer.
ctx.foundation: A deep call for change underlies this matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the power of renewal and the courage to rise.

name: XXI · The World
title: XXI · The World (Le Monde)
imagery: A nude figure, loosely draped in a sash and holding a wand, dances within an oval wreath of leaves. In the four corners appear an angel, an eagle, a lion and a bull. The whole card feels complete and in motion at once.
meaning: Le Monde is wholeness and fulfillment. A great cycle is complete, and every part of you is integrated and dancing. This card speaks of success, achievement and arrival. Celebrate what you have accomplished, and know that a new cycle will begin from this place of completeness.
numerology: Twenty-one, the final card, reduces to three: creation fulfilled and whole.
affirmation: I am whole, complete and in harmony with life.

ctx.past: You completed a major cycle in the past. That success is your foundation.
ctx.present: Fulfillment is here. You have arrived at a meaningful achievement.
ctx.future: Completion and success are coming. A long journey reaches its goal.
ctx.challenge: Fear of finishing or moving on is the obstacle. Let the cycle close.
ctx.advice: Celebrate, complete what remains and prepare for the next chapter.
ctx.self: You see yourself as whole and accomplished. You have integrated your lessons.
ctx.others: Others recognize your success. You may be part of a larger community or travel widely.
ctx.hopes: You hope for fulfillment and it is within reach.
ctx.love: Love is complete and harmonious. A relationship reaches a beautiful milestone.
ctx.work: Success, completion and recognition. A project or career goal is achieved.
ctx.spirit: Your guides celebrate with you. You are in harmony with the universe.
ctx.release: Release the old cycle with gratitude. It is complete.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a reluctance to claim your success.
ctx.foundation: Completion and wholeness underlie this matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to bring things to beautiful completion.
